institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for instantly available, nutritionally balanced, and palatable foods made from traditional millets.
description: A process to convert millet grits (pearl, little, barnyard, kodo, foxtail) and arrowroot powder into a Ready-to-Eat (RTE) porridge. The technology utilizes pressure steaming, drying, and optimized formulation to deliver a nutrient-rich and palatable food product.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-eat millet breakfast cereals • Production of commercially packaged therapeutic porridges • Processing of balanced nutritional mixes for health programs • Formulation of instant dry food bases reconstitutable with milk or water
